priorityList: Use Racial abilities and offensive trinkets on cooldown.
Use Black Ox Brew if you are talented into Aspect of Harmony and have less than one charge of Celestial Brew remaining.
Use Celestial Brew while the Aspect of Harmony (Spender) buff is active.
Use Keg Smash while both Aspect of Harmony (Spender) and Empty Barrel buffs are active.
Invoke Niuzao the Black Ox on cooldown.
Prioritize Breath of Fire and Keg Smash while Niuzao is active if talented into Wisdom of the Wall.
Use Blackout Kick to generate the Blackout Combo buff if you do not already have it.
Use Purifying Brew frequently to manage Stagger and maintain brew flow.
Cast Chi Burst on cooldown for burst AoE damage.
Use Exploding Keg on cooldown, especially when Keg Smash is recharging.
Use Empty the Cellar (Master of Harmony) on cooldown, ideally when Celestial Brew is not immediately available.
Use Keg Smash as your high-priority rotational ability to maximize damage and brew reduction.
Use Breath of Fire on cooldown to maintain damage reduction and the burning DoT on enemies.
Maintain Rushing Jade Wind for consistent passive AoE damage.
Use Blackout Kick on cooldown and Tiger Palm as a filler/energy dump.
